question: How much does the Starter plan cost per user if billed monthly?

reference_answer: You have 14 calendar days from the initial charge to request a 100% refund on a new Annual Starter or Annual Pro subscription.

reference_answer: CSV files must be no larger than 25 MB and contain at most 50,000 rows per upload.

question: What is the REST API rate limit on the Pro plan?

question: How many days does a workspace invitation stay valid before expiring?
reference_answer: Pending email invitations remain valid for 7 calendar days before expiring automatically.

reference_answer: FlowPulse retains execution logs for 7 days on the Free plan.

question: What is the webhook timeout limit?
reference_answer: Target webhook endpoints must respond with an HTTP 2xx status code within 10 seconds.

question: What is the uptime SLA for Enterprise customers?

question: How many monthly task runs are included in the Pro plan?

question: When was the Legacy Solo plan discontinued?
reference_answer: The Legacy Solo Plan was officially discontinued on January 15, 2025.

question: Are monthly subscriptions refundable?
reference_answer: No, monthly subscriptions, automatic annual renewals, and task-run overage charges are strictly non-refundable once processed.

question: How long does it take for an approved refund to appear?
reference_answer: Approved annual refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

question: How many hours before renewal must I cancel my subscription?
reference_answer: You must complete cancellation at least 24 hours before your next scheduled renewal date to avoid being billed for the upcoming cycle.

question: When do plan downgrades take effect?
reference_answer: Downgrading from Pro to Starter or reducing seat counts takes effect on your next renewal date.

question: How much do extra task runs cost when overages occur?
reference_answer: Additional usage is billed in blocks of 50,000 task runs at $10 per block.

question: How often do workspace API keys expire?
reference_answer: Workspace API keys expire every 90 days unless marked as non-expiring by an Enterprise Owner.

question: What is the API rate limit on the Enterprise plan?
reference_answer: The Enterprise plan allows up to 600 API requests per minute.

question: How frequently does Google Sheets sync run on the Starter plan?
reference_answer: On the Starter plan, Google Sheets performs automatic polling every 15 minutes.

question: What format are exported workflow definitions saved in?
reference_answer: Workflow definitions are exported as portable .json files.

question: How many backup recovery codes are generated when enabling 2FA?
reference_answer: 10 single-use 8-digit backup recovery codes are generated when you first enable 2FA.

question: What is the retry schedule for failed outbound webhooks?
reference_answer: FlowPulse retries failed webhooks 3 times at 1 minute, 5 minutes, and 30 minutes after the initial failure.

question: What date format is required for CSV imports?
reference_answer: All date fields in CSV imports must follow the ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DD.

question: Which email addresses should our IT team whitelist for FlowPulse alerts?
reference_answer: Your IT team should whitelist noreply@flowpulse.io and alerts@flowpulse.io.

question: What is the Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL for SAML SSO?
reference_answer: The Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL is https://app.flowpulse.io/auth/saml/callback.

question: Which AWS regions does FlowPulse use to host customer workspaces?
reference_answer: FlowPulse hosts customer workspaces in us-east-1 (N. Virginia, USA) and eu-central-1 (Frankfurt, Germany).

question: How long does the soft-delete grace period last after deleting a workspace?
reference_answer: Deleted workspaces enter a 30-day soft-delete grace period before permanent deletion.

question: How long are execution logs stored on the Pro plan?
reference_answer: FlowPulse retains execution logs for 365 days (1 year) on the Pro plan.

question: Which plans can request the SOC 2 Type II report?
reference_answer: Pro and Enterprise customers can request the SOC 2 Type II report after signing a mutual NDA.

reference_answer: No, deactivating a user revokes their login and frees their seat while preserving all workflows and audit history they created.

reference_answer: Cancel your plan under Settings > Billing > Manage Plan at least 24 hours before renewal; you keep paid access until the end of your current billing cycle.

reference_answer: FlowPulse retries the card on Day 1, Day 4, and Day 9. If still unpaid on Day 10, your workspace switches to a Read-Only state until updated.
